decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned, not given its own page, so commitment and carrying cost appear low; with no evidence that its value has failed, keeping the option open is cheap, though the firm's quick exit from its mining lines and its broad portfolio raise the risk of a drop.

The inclined furniture lift line got dedicated pages and is a low-cost, modular product in a steady niche, and there is no sign its value has failed, so the option is still worth more than its upkeep.
The building material lift shares technology and production with the furniture lifts, so keeping it costs little while demand from construction remains uncertain but promising.
The truck-mounted version costs more to carry and its demand is less certain, but it builds on the lift family and nothing yet shows its value cannot be realized, so the option is kept for now.
